title: Four Winters and One Short Bell
subtitle: 校园生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 校园生活（人与自我·生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：校园生活（人与自我·生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：exam　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 exam 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 my brother ① took an exam that no teacher in the school would have set, and he said the taking was the whole of the winter. The ② exam, meaning the paper itself and not the term, ran four winters and stayed unset in the book; an exam, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left unset.

Every ③ exam in that school had the same short bell beside it, and the ④ exam at the far side, meaning the one they kept for June and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An exam, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to set; my brother said the setting is the part that fills four winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the exam was the whole of the year, meaning the test and not the paper. The ⑥ exam, meaning the test and not any of that, is the only thing in a year that everybody waits for and nobody sets; exam, he said, is either something you take or the only word that means both a paper and a test. He said the test is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ exam had become a line in a timetable, and the timetable had become an argument about the short bell. The ⑧ exam of the whole thing, my brother wrote in January, was one school and four winters of setting; exam, he said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to set. He said the setting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ exam I remember is the one set in the timetable, which closed in 1972 and is still described as the quietest in the school. An ⑩ exam, my mother said in 1974, is the only one that improves by being set; every exam, she said, is a test that has agreed to look like a paper. She said the test was the honest half.

answers.why: take an exam 意为“参加一场考试”，1966 年哥哥参加了一场学校里没有一位老师肯命题的考试。
exam 意为“考试”，指那份试卷本身而不是整个学期，它经过了四个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
exam 意为“考试”，指学校里每一场旁边的那一场，每一场旁边都有同一阵短短的铃声。
exam 意为“考试”，指留给六月那一场，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
exam 意为“考验、检验”，指一年里人人都等却无人命题的那样事情，叔叔说这次检验就是那一年的全部。
exam 意为“检验”，指人人都等却无人命题的那样事情而不是那份试卷，是一年里人人都等、却无人命题的东西。
exam 意为“考试”，指时间表上写到、被排定的那一场，到 1970 年这一场成了时间表里的一行。
exam 意为“考试”，哥哥一月写道，整件事的考试之事是一所学校和四个冬天的命题。
exam 意为“考试”，我记得的是时间表上排定的那一场，1972 年结束了，至今仍被说成学校里最安静的一场。
exam 为抽象总称，母亲 1974 年说，一场考试是唯一会因为被好好命题而变得更好的东西。
